name: blender
label: Blender
description: Drive a running Blender on this machine via the official Blender Lab MCP server: inspect the scene, run bpy Python, render. Requires the official Blender MCP add-on installed + enabled in Blender (the platform installs the SERVER from git; the user installs the add-on once).
author: Blender

config.label: Blender executable for the background (_for_cli) tools

system_requirements.notes: Installs the official Blender Lab MCP server from git, so the machine needs `git` (Windows: `winget install Git.Git`; macOS: `brew install git`). Also requires Blender 5.1+ running with the official MCP add-on from the Blender Lab extension repository: in Blender, Preferences > Get Extensions > Repositories > add `https://lab.blender.org/`, then install and enable "MCP" (or drop the zip from blender.org/lab/mcp-server onto Blender twice: the first drop adds the repository, the second installs the add-on). Started, it opens a local control socket (default 127.0.0.1:9876). The platform does NOT launch Blender; the user starts it. Cross-platform (Linux X11/Wayland, macOS, Windows).

skills.description: How to drive Blender via the official MCP: check the connection, inspect the scene, then run bpy safely.
